scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/config && tsc --noEmit -p packages/wallets && tsc --noEmit -p packages/adapters && tsc --noEmit -p packages/fixtures && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/contracts && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/probes && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/checks && tsc --noEmit -p prototypes/wallet-feasibility && tsc --noEmit -p packages/database && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api
scripts.test:unit: node --test --experimental-strip-types packages/core/src/*.test.ts packages/config/src/*.test.ts packages/wallets/src/*.test.ts packages/adapters/src/*.test.ts scripts/probes/lib.test.ts prototypes/wallet-feasibility/src/*.test.ts apps/api/src/*.test.ts
scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:checks
scripts.services:up: docker compose $([ -f .env.local ] && echo --env-file .env.local) up -d --wait postgres redis
scripts.ci: pnpm lint && pnpm boundaries && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm openapi:check
